tagline: Serverless notebook and Python script tasks can use a pyproject.toml file to configure their job environment.
what_it_does: Serverless notebook and Python script tasks can use a pyproject.toml file to configure their job environment. Configure the project environment in the Jobs UI, the Jobs API, or a bundle. Workspace admins can enable Project Scoped Shared Compute on the Previews page.
why_it_matters: When a job runs, any task that shares the same set of dependencies as a completed task in the same run finishes faster, because the cache already contains the required dependencies.
plain_summary: Serverless notebook and Python script tasks can use a pyproject.toml file to configure their job environment. Configure the project environment in the Jobs UI, the Jobs API, or a bundle.
